description: April 11 birthday meaning: Aries decan 3, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 11 birthday falls in Aries, in the third decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: April 11 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 11 meets Jupiter's expansive decan of Aries on April 11, the Sun around twenty-one degrees in. Intuition, enthusiasm and a philosophical bent combine. The traditional reading is an inspired advocate, quick to believe in a cause and gifted at lighting that belief in others, provided the details are checked along the way.

On April 11 the Sun usually sits at about 21° Aries, in the third decan, where Jupiter is the sub-ruler alongside Mars. The last ten degrees of Aries fall under Jupiter, the planet that governs Sagittarius, so this decan is usually read as the most philosophical version of the Ram. The urge to act is joined by an urge to understand why, and to go further, physically or intellectually. Astrologers tend to describe these mid-April birthdays as restless explorers who argue for principles as hotly as for themselves. Jupiter can widen the horizon and also the to-do list, so enthusiasm may outrun follow-through. At its best, this decan mixes Aries nerve with a broad, hopeful outlook that makes other people braver about their own plans.

sections.heading: April 11 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 11th, you have a birthday number of 11, and because it is a master number it stays unreduced. The day of birth is a secondary number in numerology, yet master numbers are traditionally given extra weight wherever they appear. Two 1s side by side suggest doubled sensitivity as well as doubled initiative: the 11 is linked with intuition, inspiration and a nervous, creative charge. Those born on this date are often described as idealistic and perceptive, sometimes picking up on things before they can explain why. Grounding routines and trusted company tend to help them carry that intensity comfortably.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one April 11 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on April 11: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 11 is the 101st day of the year (102nd in a leap year). By April 20, 9 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 11, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on April 11 include George Canning (1770), Andrew Wiles (1953) and Alessandra Ambrosio (1981).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 11?
faq.answer: April 11 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aries, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 11?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 11 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 11th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 11?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 11 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 11?
faq.answer: April 11 is also the birthday of George Canning (1770), Andrew Wiles (1953) and Alessandra Ambrosio (1981). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
